title: Search
lead: Look for a movie in your library and in every release source at once. What the sources list is kept for a day, so filtering and sorting never ask them again.
expired: This search is no longer available. Search again.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed, showing the search as it was last loaded.

library.unlisted_other: {{value}} more movies in your library hold these words.

inLibrary.TitleAndYear: In your library: {{work}} — matched by title and year
